epistemic_boundary_declaration: Stage convergence (cmp zcc2.s zcc3.s exit 0) establishes that the tested bootstrap generations converged to byte-identical assembly under the recorded environment and inputs. Per ZCC Epistemic Protocol, this is necessary evidence of bootstrap reproducibility but does not, by itself, prove universal semantic correctness. Compiler correctness is established by independent oracles including GCC/Clang differential execution, SystemV ABI corpus, and full external application gauntlets (Lua, SQLite, QuickJS, DOOM).
